Hi all — quick answers and proposed evidence bundle. I’ve pulled the items we typically provide for CAIQ prefill: 

Answers to Markus’ questions:
- Subprocessors: yes — included in attachment (subprocessors_list.csv). We can share names; for partner contracts with NDAs we may redact contact info but names/services are ok.
- SOC 2: we can provide a SOC 2 summary + control mapping document now (soc2_summary_redwood_2025.pdf). The full report requires an NDA and auditor approval; we can coordinate if needed.
- Encryption/KMS: default is AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit. We support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-key) for Dedicated and Private deployments; hosted customers can use our KMS with optional HSM-backed keys on request (can document in CAIQ field A.8.1).
- Logs and retention: default request logs retained 180 days. We can support shorter windows (90 days) or longer (365) for contractual SLAs on Dedicated/Private; hosted customers can request extended retention with an add-on.
- EU hosting: we have EU-only tenancy options (Frankfurt, Dublin) and we can pin instances to EU regions for data residency requirements.

Recommended evidence bundle to return to PortfolioTech (attached):
- sig_prefill_completed.xlsx (prefilled CAIQ fields where applicable)
- soc2_summary_redwood_2025.pdf (control overview + readiness comments)
- subprocessors_list.csv

Proposed timeline: we’ll aim to deliver the prefilled CAIQ + attachments by 2026-07-29 (10 business days). If legal prefers SIG-Lite first, we can drop a condensed bundle by 2026-07-20.

Notes for sales: emphasize CAIQ + SOC summary for legal, and call out EU tenancy + BYOK options for procurement.

Attachments: subprocessors_list.csv, soc2_summary_redwood_2025.pdf, sig_prefill_completed.xlsx
